notes: Suite 366 1.34.0, chart 0.11.0. A new AI model can be selected on the box: RaLLM v2.4, the Qwen3.8 27B fine-tuned by Devana for the Suite 366 assistant. It is better at deciding between calling a tool and answering, makes far fewer unneeded tool calls, and runs at the same speed and in the same memory as the default model, which does not change. Switching to it from the model page downloads 22 GB once, and its first start takes about 8 minutes. CRM dashboards: cumulative flow and created-versus-resolved tiles, and redesigned charts on six pages. PersonIA: the tasks it scheduled are listed on the bots page and can be stopped there. Meetings: a scheduled meeting creates its calendar event. Pages: search and favourites for spaces. Chat: a mention notification shows the message excerpt and where it was posted. Dictation: a launcher in the header. Drive: seeking inside a video or an audio preview works. Updating restarts the application (database migrations run at startup); the AI models keep running.
